```yaml
name: Build Debian Packages

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  release:
    types: [ created ]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-deb:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    strategy:
      matrix:
        variant: [ basic, hardsubx ]
    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        submodules: recursive

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install -y build-essential devscripts debhelper cmake pkg-config libpng-dev libjpeg-dev libtiff-dev libfreetype6-dev libfontconfig1-dev libharfbuzz-dev libfribidi-dev libass-dev libvpx-dev libopus-dev libvorbis-dev libtheora-dev libspeex-dev libwebp-dev libx264-dev libx265-dev libmp3lame-dev libfdk-aac-dev libvo-amrwbenc-dev libaom-dev libdav1d-dev libsvtav1enc-dev libopenjp2-7-dev libopenexr-dev libilmbase-dev libboost-all-dev libcurl4-gnutls-dev libssl-dev libxml2-dev libxslt1-dev libzip-dev libarchive-dev libpcre2-dev libglib2.0-dev libgstreamer1.0-dev libgstreamer-plugins-base1.0-dev libgstreamer-plugins-bad1.0-dev libgstreamer-plugins-good1.0-dev libgstreamer-plugins-ugly1.0-dev libgstreamer-vaapi1.0-dev libgstreamer-video1.0-dev libgstreamer-app1.0-dev libgstreamer-pbutils1.0-dev libgstreamer-tag1.0-dev libgstreamer-rtp1.0-dev libgstreamer-rtsp1.0-dev libgstreamer-sdp1.0-dev libgstreamer-webrtc1.0-dev libgstreamer-rtsp-server1.0-dev

    - name: Setup build environment
      run: |
        mkdir -p build
        cd build
        cmake .. -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release

    - name: Build GPAC
      run: |
        git clone https://github.com/gpac/gpac.git
        cd gpac
        git checkout abi-16.4
        mkdir -p build
        cd build
        cmake .. -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DENABLE_STATIC=ON
        make -j$(nproc)
        sudo make install

    - name: Build CCExtractor
      run: |
        cd build
        make -j$(nproc)

    - name: Create Debian package structure
      run: |
        mkdir -p ccextractor-${{ matrix.variant }}/DEBIAN
        mkdir -p ccextractor-${{ matrix.variant }}/usr/bin
        mkdir -p ccextractor-${{ matrix.variant }}/usr/lib
        mkdir -p ccextractor-${{ matrix.variant }}/usr/share/doc/ccextractor
        mkdir -p ccextractor-${{ matrix.variant }}/usr/share/man/man1
        cp ../build/ccextractor ccextractor-${{ matrix.variant }}/usr/bin/
        cp ../LICENSE ccextractor-${{ matrix.variant }}/usr/share/doc/ccextractor/
        cp ../README.md ccextractor-${{ matrix.variant }}/usr/share/doc/ccextractor/

    - name: Create control file
      run: |
        cat > ccextractor-${{ matrix.variant }}/DEBIAN/control << EOF
        Package: ccextractor-${{ matrix.variant }}
        Version: $(git describe --tags --always)
        Section: video
        Priority: optional
        Architecture: amd64
        Depends: libc6 (>= 2.27), libgcc-s1 (>= 3.0), libstdc++6 (>= 5.2)
        Maintainer: CCExtractor Team <team@ccextractor.org>
        Description: CCExtractor - Closed Caption Extractor
         CCExtractor is a tool to extract closed captions from video files.
         This package includes the ${{{ matrix.variant }}} variant with ${{{ matrix.variant == 'basic' ? 'OCR support' : 'FFmpeg support' }}}.
        EOF

    - name: Create postinst script
      run: |
        cat > ccextractor-${{ matrix.variant }}/DEBIAN/postinst << 'EOF'
        #!/bin/bash
        set -e
        if [ "$1" = "configure" ]; then
          echo "CCExtractor ${{ matrix.variant }} installed successfully"
        fi
        exit 0
        EOF
        chmod +x ccextractor-${{ matrix.variant }}/DEBIAN/postinst

    - name: Create postrm script
      run: |
        cat > ccextractor-${{ matrix.variant }}/DEBIAN/postrm << 'EOF'
        #!/bin/bash
        set -e
        if [ "$1" = "remove" ]; then
          echo "CCExtractor ${{ matrix.variant }} removed"
        fi
        exit 0
        EOF
        chmod +x ccextractor-${{ matrix.variant }}/DEBIAN/postrm

    - name: Create package
      run: |
        cd ..
        dpkg-deb --build ccextractor-${{ matrix.variant }}

    - name: Upload artifact
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: ccextractor-${{ matrix.variant }}.deb
        path: ccextractor-${{ matrix.variant }}.deb

    - name: Attach to release
      if: github.event_name == 'release'
      uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      with:
        upload_url: ${{ github.event.release.upload_url }}
        asset_path: ccextractor-${{ matrix.variant }}.deb
        asset_name: ccextractor-${{ matrix.variant }}.deb
        asset_content_type: application/x-debian-package
```
